title: Fragments
description:
Split a large message into packets and put it back together.

```
message of 3000 bytes, max 1200 per packet -> 3 fragments
received 2, 0, 1 -> complete, 3000 bytes, identical: true
received 0, 2 only -> incomplete (missing 1)
```
hints: The receiver keeps `std::map<std::uint16_t, std::vector<std::optional<std::string>>>`; a message is complete when no slot is empty.
requirements: Each fragment has a message id, its index, the fragment count and its data.
The receiver collects fragments per message id and returns the message once all have arrived, in any order.
Duplicate fragments are ignored; a message older than 64 ids is thrown away.
stretch: Refuse messages that would need more than 255 fragments.
